verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an Admin API that gives programmatic access to all resources, including flags, projects, environments, users and integrations. The API powers the Admin UI itself and is meant for automation. Access is through documented API tokens for tools and automation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and endpoint-level reference detail (e.g. an OpenAPI spec) in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
This API powers the Unleash Admin UI and enables automation workflows.
The Admin API provides comprehensive programmatic access to all Unleash resources.
Unleash uses API keys to facilitate communication between consuming clients such as SDKs, Unleash Edge, or other tools and automation.
